# Maps and biomes

_Generated from `content/maps`, `content/biomes`, `scripts/match/world.gd`._

Maps are JSON layouts in `content/maps/`. Each expedition tier names its map (`Data.TIERS` "map"): The Meadow and Dusk Isles on **The Hollow Crown**; The Hollow on **The Riven Wilds**. Everything on a layout is fixed; each match only rolls which spawn points, lairs and caches are live, plus loot, the Blight and the weather.

## The Arena

The practice arena: one round floor ringed by low ruin walls with four gates, four 2x2 stone blocks to slam people into, a raised dais on the north side for high ground, two patches of tall grass, and a small bench islet to the south across a short bridge (where the generator puts spawn points; the arena itself teleports you to the floor). No monsters, chests or breakables are spawned on it.

**Getting around:** 1 bridges.



## The Hollow Crown

Hand-made expedition map (tools/make_hollowcrown.py; the format is described there). A raised core (the Crown, its Throne and two boss Gaols), a ring of four regions each with one plateau reached by stairs, and four quiet outer isles with the exits. Nothing is placed by dice except what the match rolls: which spawn points, lairs and camps are live, loot, the Blight, weather.

| Cinder Steps | Ember | Western forge country: the Kilns overlook the Crown's west face; the Ash Bridge to the Ashen Gaol. |

## The Riven Wilds

Hand-made expedition map for the top tier (tools/make_riven.py; format in tools/make_hollowcrown.py). A raised core (the Rift and its Sanctum), a ring of six regions each with one plateau up its stairs and most with a boss lair, six outer isles with the landings and exits, four corner rocks, and a winding sky train between the ring and the outer isles. Every height is walked up: no perches or jump pads.

### Regions

| Region | Biome | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| The Rift | Gloom | Contested core: the vault on the Sanctum, the richest loot and the most Blight. Two land bridges (north and south); glide in from the four diagonal regions. |
| Rimeholt | Frost | Northern frost ridge: the Keep's plateau looks down the Rime Span into the Rift; no lair, the vault's favourite. |
| Galewrack | Storm | Storm-lashed tableland with the Thunderwell (the Sky Serpent) and the longest glide into the Rift. |
| Slagmarch | Ember | Ember country: the Kilnworks plateau over the Slag Forge (the Colossus); the train's Rift run starts at its feet. |
| Briarmaw | Bloom | Thick bramble wood, ambush country: a Boki nest, the Briar Hive (the Brood Mother) and the Briar Span to the Rift. |
| Fallowmere | Meadow | Long-grass meadow with a Boki nest, Haystack Rise and the Barrowdeep (the Colossus). |
| Gloamwood | Gloom | Dim wood round the shrine on Shrine Hill, with the Gloam Nest (the Brood Mother). |
| Windward Shoal | Storm | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |
| Ashfall Ledge | Ember | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |
| Thistlewick | Bloom | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |
| Larkspur Rest | Meadow | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |
| Hoarfrost Isle | Frost | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |
| Duskcairn | Gloom | Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out. |

## Skyreach

Hand-made expedition map. Big walkable regions: the Heart in the middle, four large regions around it (Frostkeep N, Stormreach E, Bloomwild S, Ember Quarry W), four calm corner islands and four outer landings. A ring road of wide bridges joins every region to its corners, so most of the map can be walked. Only six bridges and one wind road lead into the Heart: these are the chokepoints. Perches float over the four diagonal gaps; reach them by a one-way pad or an updraft chain and glide back down. Angles are degrees around an island's centre (0 = east, 90 = south); 'sheer' arcs can't be grabbed, every other rim has a stone lip. Exits: skiff docks on the four landings, walled uplink outposts on three corner islands, rift hatches scattered over the regions. Three boss lairs (walled arenas sealed by a gate) sit on the Quarry, Stormreach and Bloomwild. Generated by tools/make_skyreach.py.

## First Flight

The tutorial island group: a flat starter meadow, a low rise across a wide bridge (one clean step up, for climbing), and the gate isle you glide or walk to, with a small walled outpost whose uplink is the way home. No rocks, no hazards, nothing random.

### Islands

**Exits:** 1 uplink outposts.

**Getting around:** 2 bridges, 1 updrafts, 1 wind roads.



## Biomes

Each region has a biome (`content/biomes/`): its colours, its monsters and its hazards.

| Biome | Id | In short | Monsters | Hazards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bloomwild | `bloom` | Overgrown and poisonous: spore pods burst when you get close, toxic monsters leave clouds. | Thorn Skitter, Spore Spitter, Bloom Puffbomb, Moss Brute | spore pod |
| Emberfall | `ember` | Lava vents erupt on a warning glow; molten monsters leave burning ground. | Cinder Skitter, Ash Spitter, Ember Puffbomb, Magma Brute | lava vent |
| Frostreach | `frost` | Ice underfoot and frozen monsters: hits slow you, and they shatter when they die. | Frost Skitter, Rime Spitter, Ice Sentinel, Glacier Brute | ice patch |
| Gloomheart | `gloom` | The void leaks through here: rifts pull you in, void monsters blink, and the loot is the best on the map. | Shade Skitter, Rift Spitter, Void Sentinel, Hollow Brute | void rift |
| Greenreach | `meadow` | Calm meadows. Few monsters, rarely anything nasty. | Meadow Skitter, Spitter, Puffbomb, Brute |  |
| Stormcrest | `storm` | Lightning rods strike marked circles; charged monsters arc their hits to a second target. | Spark Skitter, Volt Sentinel, Static Puffbomb, Thunder Brute | lightning rod |
